lg.$description: Large icon, e.g. empty-state illustrations — standard stroke (2)

default.$description: Standard stroke weight — used at md and lg sizes

dense.$description: Dense stroke weight — used at xs and sm sizes to preserve legibility at small scale

outline.$description: Default variant for all icons. Stroke only, no fill.

filled.$description: Reserved for navigation active states only. Filled variants are not assigned speculatively — each must be explicitly required by a navigation component.
